name: illustrator-vector-panel
description: CEP vector tracing panel for Adobe Illustrator

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/panel.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=iife --target=chrome99 --outfile=extension/js/panel.js && esbuild src/pipeline-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --outfile=extension/js/pipeline-worker.js && esbuild src/lab-client.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --target=chrome120 --outfile=lab/lab.js
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --test src/score.test.ts src/trace.test.ts src/png-alpha.test.ts src/edit.test.ts src/segment.test.ts src/poster-pipeline.test.ts src/selection.test.ts src/lab-model.test.ts src/lab-pipeline.test.ts src/preset-state.test.ts src/color.test.ts src/flat-trace.test.ts src/placement-svg.test.ts src/placement-geometry.test.ts src/step-selection.test.ts src/thumbnail-state.test.ts src/crop-geometry.test.ts
